title: Anth.us-Papyrus: environment-driven staging guards (fail-safe; off only for explicit production builds)
description:
Make the staging guards automatic so a production deploy deactivates them and every other build keeps them, with no manual edits at cutover.

DESIGN (agreed 2026-10-03):
- One switch, SITE_ENV, read once by web/build_via_papyrus.py. PRODUCTION only when SITE_ENV=production AND (if AWS_BRANCH is set, Amplify CI) AWS_BRANCH=main. Everything else (unset, local, any other branch) = GUARDED. Fail-safe: a mistake yields an unindexed site, never an indexed staging copy.
- Controlled by the switch: <meta name=robots noindex,nofollow> (guarded only); robots.txt Disallow:/ (guarded) vs allow + Sitemap: https://anth.us/sitemap.xml (production); footer staging note (guarded only); canonical/og:url/sitemap origin (production = https://anth.us; guarded = https://<AWS_BRANCH>.<AWS_APP_ID>.amplifyapp.com or ANTHUS_SITE_ORIGIN, localhost fallback); analytics (production only, matching live anth.us's setup incl. its opt-out script; off when guarded).
- Build-time assertions: production build fails unless origin == https://anth.us and no page contains noindex or the staging note; guarded build fails if any page lacks them.
- X-Robots-Tag is Amplify app config, not artifact: keep it permanently on the staging app (d2hbn1ig6nqyhy) as a safety net; production app must never have it. customHttp.yml must not apply noindex to production (note: customHttp.yml is app-wide in Amplify; document the per-app approach).
- Post-deploy checker script (bin/check-guards.py <url> --expect production|guarded) curls the live host and verifies meta, robots.txt, X-Robots-Tag and canonical origin.
- Recommended topology: separate production Amplify app for anth.us connected to main with SITE_ENV=production; staging app stays permanent staging. Topology choice not yet confirmed by Ryan; the code is topology-independent.
Docs: update AGENTS.md (staging section, deploy, canonical URLs) and amplify.yml.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Implemented on branch feature/PPY-f1f0a8-env-staging-guards (AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus, based on e4023f8; pushed, no PR). Commits: c7b98f6 (site_env.py + check-guards.py + tests; this one also contains the sitemap logic), b6030f9 (hooks in build_via_papyrus.py/anthus_dom.py), 917f096 (empty marker commit for PPY-0ba000, sitemap code is actually in c7b98f6), 33f1fbc (docs).
Switch: web/site_env.py. Production iff SITE_ENV=production and AWS_BRANCH unset/main; otherwise guarded (loud warning for production-on-other-branch and unknown values). Mode+origin printed first. End-of-build assert_dist over all 194 HTML pages + robots.txt + sitemaps.
Verified: (1) guarded build with staging origin passes; diff vs base build = only the new <link rel=sitemap> line on 194 pages, sitemap.xml replaced by sitemap-index.xml + sitemap-0.xml (193 URLs; 404 excluded). (2) SITE_ENV=production: canonical/og on https://anth.us on all pages, 0 noindex, 0 staging notes, robots Allow:/ + Sitemap https://anth.us/sitemap-index.xml, no analytics yet (hook only; analytics_enabled exposed, to be wired to the Papyrus capability). (3) SITE_ENV=production AWS_BRANCH=feature-x: guarded + warning, 194 noindex. (4) 8 negative mutations on real dist copies all fail the build assertions; tests/test_site_env.py (5 tests) pass. (5) bin/check-guards.py <staging> --expect guarded: all page/robots/header/canonical checks PASS; sitemap-index.xml checks FAIL on the live staging because it still serves the pre-change build (passes after redeploy; --no-sitemap skips). --expect production against staging fails (18 checks).
Live anth.us analytics (for the Papyrus capability): gatsby-plugin-google-gtag, trackingIds ["G-31SC26SDGX"], pluginConfig {head:true}; head carries <link rel="preconnect" href="https://www.googletagmanager.com"/>, <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://www.googletagmanager.com"/>, <script async src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-31SC26SDGX"></script>, then <script>window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[];function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}gtag('js',new Date());gtag('config','G-31SC26SDGX',{"send_page_view":false});</script> (wrapped in if(true){}). Page views are sent by the plugin's onRouteUpdate: gtag('event','page_view',{page_path: pathname+search+hash}) after 2 rAF. Opt-out (gatsby-ssr.js, injected as the FIRST head element, before everything): <script>(function(){try{var k='anthus-no-analytics',q=location.search.match(/[?&]notrack=(\w+)/);if(q){if(q[1]==='1')localStorage.setItem(k,'1');else localStorage.removeItem(k)}if(localStorage.getItem(k)==='1')window['ga-disable-G-31SC26SDGX']=true}catch(e){}})();</script> -- ?notrack=1 sets localStorage flag, ?notrack=0 clears; flag disables GA via ga-disable-<ID>.
Topology (staging app keeps X-Robots-Tag; separate production app on main with SITE_ENV=production) is documented as recommended and NOT confirmed by Ryan. customHttp.yml no longer carries X-Robots-Tag (app-wide file); staging header is app config only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: TOPOLOGY DECIDED (Ryan, 2026-10-03): ONE Amplify app (d2hbn1ig6nqyhy), TWO branches. main = production (branch env var SITE_ENV=production; anth.us domain at cutover). staging = guarded build on its amplifyapp.com URL. NO X-Robots-Tag header (app-wide in Amplify, would hit production) and NO basic auth: staging is guarded by the build-enforced noindex meta + robots.txt Disallow only, verified by bin/check-guards.py after each deploy. TODO in integration: update check-guards.py so --expect guarded no longer requires X-Robots-Tag; update AGENTS.md topology section; remove the app-level X-Robots-Tag customHeader before main goes live; Ryan connects the repo in the Amplify console (GitHub OAuth).

comments.text: Integrated on AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus branch feature/anthus-integration @ 7b7f339 (design-parity base + env/staging guards + real-404 merged; pin c98435f; pushed, no PR, not deployed). Topology applied: one Amplify app d2hbn1ig6nqyhy, main=production (SITE_ENV=production), staging=guarded; no X-Robots-Tag requirement in check-guards (production still requires its absence). AGENTS.md notes the app-level X-Robots-Tag header must be removed before main goes live. Analytics (GA4 + opt-out) only in production: 194/194 pages in prod build, 0 in guarded.
